recognize_zh: 低倍下可見許多比周圍造血細胞大數倍的組織球，細胞質豐富、淡藍灰色且帶纖維狀條紋（像皺褶的薄紙），核小而偏位，成群散布於骨髓顆粒中，為高雪氏細胞（Gaucher cells）。
features: Numerous very large histiocytes clustered within the marrow particle
Abundant pale blue-grey cytoplasm with fibrillary, striated 'crumpled tissue paper' texture
Small, eccentric, round to oval nuclei, some cells multinucleated
Background of normal hematopoietic cells, including a megakaryocyte (bottom center)
Abundant erythrocytes in the aspirate background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at intermediate power shows numerous large histiocytes clustered within marrow particles. These cells have small eccentric nuclei and abundant pale blue-grey cytoplasm with a fibrillary, crumpled tissue paper appearance. Background trilineage hematopoiesis, including a megakaryocyte, is present. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cells; the diagnosis of Gaucher disease should be confirmed by glucocerebrosidase enzyme assay and GBA1 genotyping.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells (CML, myeloma, thalassemia, mycobacterial infection)
ddx.vs: Morphologically similar, but occur with an underlying disorder and normal glucocerebrosidase activity; mycobacteria-laden histiocytes are AFB-positive.
Foam cells have uniformly vacuolated, bubbly cytoplasm and sea-blue lipid rather than fibrillary striations.
Histiocytes contain coarse blue-green granules of ceroid rather than a wrinkled fibrillar cytoplasm.
Tumor cells form cohesive clusters with high N:C ratio, atypical nuclei and prominent nucleoli.
